physical_authority.composition: immutable V1 target base plus non-overlapping V2 target delta
physical_authority.delta_permitted_use: development-outcome freeze and prospective-boundary authority; training requires a matching admitted V2 feature row and is therefore bounded by the feature authority

decision_schedule: XNYS regular session five-minute bar close
entry_price_rule: last finalised five-minute source bar close at decision
exit_price_rule: five-minute source bar close at elapsed horizon
target_start_rule: decision timestamp after source bar finalisation
target_end_rule: decision timestamp plus 60 elapsed market minutes
availability_rule: after target-ending source bar is finalised
score_rule: features may be scored without target availability
session_boundary_rule: must mature within the same regular session
missing_bar_policy: required five-minute source bars; no silent skip

calendar.early_close_policy: maintained calendar close; near-close targets conflict

prospective_validation_start_rule: first XNYS trading session after the maximum historical outcome timestamp consumed by the clean tournament freeze
prospective_start_calendar_proof: next XNYS session after 2026-09-23 under market_calendar_authority.v1 / exchange_calendars 4.13.2
prospective_start_status: FROZEN_PROSPECTIVELY; DO NOT REPRESENT ANY EARLIER PERIOD AS UNTOUCHED HOLDOUT
